# Mount Pilatus Cogwheel Railway and Cable Car [Experience](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/experiences/ "Experience")[Pilatus](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/destinations/pilatus/ "To the overview page «Pilatus»") Media gallery ## Overview - Open Information About Map Map ### Hint Pilatus Lucerne – Lake Lucerne [Show on map](https://www.myswitzerland.com/en-ch/map/#around:46.9795646697,8.2555572092;cat:e7bd1c2b-91dd-4d6a-b937-be4909cd36cc;lat:46.97956;lng:8.25556;z:15 "Auf Karte zeigen") Shoot Information About Map - Open Information About Contact Address ### Contact **PILATUS-BAHNEN AG - Hotels & Gastronomie** Schlossweg 1 6010 Kriens Phone  [+41 (0)41 329 12 12](tel:+41413291212 "+41 (0)41 329 12 12") [pilatus.ch](http://www.pilatus.ch/ "Website") [Plan your route](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=46.979596145889246%2C8.254926787188687 "Plan your route") Shoot Information About Contact ## Intro Easily accessible by public transport from Lucerne, Mount Pilatus is the ideal adventure mountain for the entire family. The world’s steepest cogwheel railway starts its climb at Alpnachstad and tackles a maximum gradient of 48 percent, thereby passing forests, meadows and rock faces. On the north side, a gondola cableway and an aerial cableway connect Kriens to Pilatus Kulm. With the aerial cableway "Dragon Ride", guests are practically flying up to Pilatus. It takes the cableway a mere 3.5 minutes to reach Pilatus (2,132 m a.s.l.) from the intermediate station Fräkmüntegg (1,416 m a.s.l.). Thanks to spacious seating, a cockpit-like structure and large windows, the cableway offers a unique view of Lucerne and its lake. ### Information | **Altitude:** | 2,132 m a.s.l. | | **Arrival:** | Bus number 1 from Lucerne Station to Kriens/Zentrum Pilatus
Gondola from Kriens (Lucerne) via Krienseregg to Fräkmuntegg, aerial cableway to Pilatus Kulm or cog railway (only during summer) from Alpnachstad (boat or train from Lucerne) to Pilatus Kulm | | **Timetable:** | - Gondola and aerial cableway operate year-round except revision period, please consult [timetable](https://pilatus.ch/en/railway-cableways/timetable)
- Cogwheel railway operates only during the summer season, please consult [timetable](https://pilatus.ch/en/railway-cableways/timetable) | | **Travel duration to summit:** | 40 mins | | **Attractions:** | - The world’s steepest cog railway from Alpnachstad to Pilatus (48% gradient), spectacular passage “Eselwand”
- "Golden Round Trip" Luzern–Kriens–Fräkmüntegg–Pilatus Kulm–Alpnachstad–Luzern (bus, cableway and boat)
- Cliff walk and secured trails to the viewpoint Oberhaupt
- Rope park and summer toboggan run Fräkmüntegg | | **Food & beverage:** | Evening summit rendezvous in summer (from Alpnachstad), Restaurant Krienseregg and Restaurant Chalet, Hotel Pilatus-Kulm | | **Specials:** | - 50% discount with [Swiss Travel Pass, Swiss Travel Pass Flex](https://www.sbb.ch/en/tickets-offers/tickets/guests-abroad/swiss-travel-pass.html), Swiss Half Fare Card and Interrail
- Buy your tickets [online](https://pilatus.ch/en/railway-cableways/tickets) or on arrival at the station | More information about Pilatus [here](https://www.pilatus.ch/en/) [![](https://media.myswitzerland.com/image/fetch/c_fit,w_200,h_200/f_auto,q_auto/https://www.myswitzerland.com/-/media/st/images/swisstainable%20logos/swisstainable-engaged-st0072835.png)\\ \\*\\* Engaged](http://www.swisstainable.ch/) ## General information ClickToViewContent | Season | All year | | Accessibility | Accessible | Show Technical information content ### SBB RailAway leisure offer With SBB RailAway leisure offers, you receive attractive discounts on leisure attractions and travel on public transport.
